tests.label: Does the PEER pNGB low-f family remain viable after adding new SPT-3G D1 lensing while confronting ACT primary-CMB stress and the SH0ES-driven high-H0 direction?
tests.summary: New SPT D1 lensing is compatible with two exact native pNGB witnesses at ~0.8 sigma.
